item.title: Defence ministry mourns Qatar Amiri Naval Forces serviceman
item.description:
The Ministry of Defence on Monday mourned Lance Corporal Ammar Yasser Arafat Mohammed of the Qatar Amiri Naval Forces, who was martyred while performing his military duty. The ministry offered condolences to his family and did not give details of the circumstances.

item.title: Qatar Airways to resume Malta flights on 22 March 2027
item.description:
Qatar Airways announced on Monday it will resume flights to Malta from 22 March 2027, with three weekly services from Hamad International Airport. The airline will fly an Airbus A320 with 12 Business and 120 Economy seats on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays, and bookings are now open.

item.title: Al Shamal come from behind to beat Al Ahli Saudi 3-2
item.description:
Al Shamal beat defending champions Al Ahli Saudi 3-2 on Monday evening at Al Bayt Stadium in the fifth round of the AFC Champions League Elite. Al Ahli led through Feras Al-Brikan and Ivan Toney before Baghdad Bounedjah, Tiago Silva and Alex Collado scored in the 62nd, 72nd and 91st minutes. Al Shamal moved to 8 points in seventh place.
Sources: Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7-%D8%AB%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A7-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%87%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%AF%D9%85-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B9 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738862/sport/football/collados-last-gasp-stunner-helps-al-shamal-shock-saudis-al-ahli

item.title: QRDI says 1,580 undergraduate projects funded in 20 years
item.description:
The Qatar Research, Development and Innovation Council said on Monday its Undergraduate Research Experience Program has funded more than 1,580 projects since launch, involving over 6,200 students. More than 1,280 projects have been completed with over 500 research outputs, and 50% of grantees later won funding from other council programmes.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/qrdi-says-more-than-1580-projects-funded-through-urep-since-launch · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266006/latest-news/qrdi-says-more-than-1580-projects-funded-through-urep-since-launch · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB-%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AB%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-1580-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B9%D8%A7-%D8%B9%D8%A8%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AC-%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AB-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B0-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%87

item.title: Web Summit committee signs MoU with German SME association
item.description:
The Permanent Committee for Hosting Web Summit signed a memorandum of understanding in Bonn with Germany’s BVMW association for small and medium-sized businesses, on the sidelines of HH the Amir’s state visit to Germany. The agreement provides for joint promotional events in Germany for Web Summit Qatar and easier participation by German technology firms.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/permanent-committee-for-hosting-web-summit-signs-mou-with-german-bvmw · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266007/latest-news/permanent-committee-for-hosting-web-summit-signs-mou-with-german-bvmw · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%81%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%81-%D8%A8%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1

item.title: Qatar Customs earns ISO 27001 information security certification
item.description:
The General Authority of Customs has obtained ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for its information security management system after meeting the standard’s data protection and risk requirements. Assistant Chairman for Support Services Ali Mohammed Al Kubaisi received the certificate after the assessment was completed.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265996/latest-news/customs-authority-obtains-iso-certification-for-its-information-security-management-system · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/qatar-customs-obtains-isoiec-270012022-certification-in-information-security-management

item.title: Washington imposes new sanctions on Iranian shadow banking network
item.description:
The US Treasury on Monday imposed new sanctions on more than two dozen Iranian exchange houses, front companies and financial operatives accused of moving billions of dollars through a shadow banking network. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called the system Tehran’s “last financial lifeline” and vowed to keep dismantling it.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · Emarat Al Youm (Reuters) https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/news/2026-11-23-1.2105675

item.title: US crude falls below $80 for first time since August
item.description:
West Texas Intermediate fell more than 4% on Monday to $79.95 a barrel, below $80 for the first time since August, while Brent dropped 4.1% to $88.75. Reuters attributed the slide to higher Middle Eastern supply and the restart of a Libyan pipeline, despite continuing threats to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · Gulf News (Reuters) https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-5-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-nov-23-2026-1.500758468 · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CL%3DF/

item.title: Dubai index rises 1.3% as Kuwait bourse slips 0.20%
item.description:
Dubai’s main index rose 1.3% at Monday’s close and Abu Dhabi’s edged up 0.1%. In Kuwait, the All Share Index fell 0.20% to 8,444.18 points and the Main 50 Index dropped 1.97%. The MSX 30 Index in Muscat closed 0.08% higher at 7,209.79 points.
Sources: Gulf News (Reuters) https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-5-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-nov-23-2026-1.500758468 · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/kuwait-stock-exchange-closes-lower-as-all-market-indices-decline · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/muscat-stock-exchange-closes-higher

item.title: Central Bank of Oman launches first government Islamic treasury bills
item.description:
The Central Bank of Oman on Monday announced its first auction of government Islamic treasury bills, with 28, 91, 182 and 364-day tenors offered electronically to licensed banks. The bills aim to widen Sharia-compliant short-term investment options, diversify government funding tools and support bank liquidity management.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/oman-central-bank-launches-first-islamic-treasury-bills-auction · Times of Oman (ONA) https://timesofoman.com/article/179525-cbo-announces-first-issuance-of-government-islamic-treasury-bills

item.title: Saudi Arabia orders 50% Saudisation of 17 financial professions
item.description:
Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, with the Saudi Organisation for Chartered and Professional Accountants, announced that 50% of 17 private-sector financial professions must be held by citizens from 23 May 2027. The rule covers firms with two or more staff in roles such as financial analyst, investment manager and credit manager, with a six-month grace period.
Sources: Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/media-center/news/%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%87%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B5 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/economy/2026/11/23/saudi-arabia-tightens-rules-to-boost-employment-of-citizens-in-finance-jobs-by-may/

item.title: Egypt and Iraq sign cooperation documents at joint higher committee
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly and his Iraqi counterpart Ali Falih Al-Zaidi on Monday evening chaired the fourth session of the Egyptian-Iraqi Joint Higher Committee in the New Capital. The two sides signed documents including a double taxation agreement and memoranda on medicines, broadcasting, fisheries and nuclear regulation.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7630078 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7630086 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7192046 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=5910253b-d42d-4124-a2dc-12d63a30d1f4

item.title: Iraqi prime minister invites Egyptian firms to join development projects
item.description:
The prime ministers of Egypt and Iraq met representatives of Egyptian companies at the cabinet headquarters on Monday evening, on the sidelines of the joint committee. Madbouly said Egyptian firms were ready to join Iraqi development projects, while Al-Zaidi outlined incentives including tax and customs exemptions and protection for local products.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7192033 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/23/3083490 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7192063

item.title: Pyramids beat Al Ahly 2-0 to keep perfect league record
item.description:
Pyramids beat Al Ahly 2-0 on Monday evening at Cairo Stadium in the ninth round of the Egyptian Premier League. Karim Hafez scored a 32nd-minute penalty and Mostafa Fathy added a second in the 48th minute. Pyramids moved to 27 points with nine straight wins, while Al Ahly dropped to third on 20 points.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=0fe2a82b-eef7-4178-bbfc-897ceb1e17fe · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7630164 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7192087

item.title: Gold in Egypt rises as 21-carat tops EGP5,700
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose on Monday as the global ounce climbed about 3.8%. The 21-carat grade reached EGP5,720 in evening trade according to Masrawy and EGP5,745 according to Sada El Balad, against EGP5,565 on Sunday. The gold pound stood between EGP45,760 and EGP45,960.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/23/3083358 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7191726

item.title: Egypt forecasts slight temperature drop and morning fog on Tuesday
item.description:
Egypt’s Meteorological Authority expects a continued slight drop in temperatures on Tuesday 24 November across the north to Greater Cairo, with fog that may be dense from 4am to 10am. Light rain has about a 30% chance on the northern coasts, and forecaster Mahmoud El-Qayati said winter would be near normal.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7629644 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7192000

item.title: Wall Street surges as Nvidia jumps more than 30%
item.description:
US stocks closed sharply higher on Monday, with the S&P 500 up 4.74% at 7,237.71, the Nasdaq up 6.49% at 24,084.52 and the Dow up 3.06%. Nvidia shares jumped 31.28% to $164.79 after Jensen Huang was reinstated as chief executive, adding nearly $1 trillion to its market value.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/nvidia-leads-wall-street-rebound · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EGSPC/ · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/technology/nvidia-stock-surges-33-as-jensen-huang-returns-as-ceo-after-shock-board-reversal-1.500758380

item.title: UN mission calls for independent probe into Benghazi port attacks
item.description:
The UN Support Mission in Libya on Monday called for an independent investigation into Sunday’s attacks at Benghazi port and off its coast, which sank a Russian warship and hit a commercial vessel. It warned that Libya “must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts”, while Libya’s House of Representatives said it reserved the right to take all measures.
Sources: UN News https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168857 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=d29ba9a2-8100-46a5-b004-2969d8996eeb

item.title: Fighting in Ituri traps Ebola responders in DR Congo
item.description:
WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province forced agency staff and Ebola responders to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. He called for their immediate safe passage, as WHO has verified more than 87 attacks on healthcare in the country since 1 January.
Sources: UN News https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168858 · Al Jazeera English (AFP, Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/who-chief-calls-for-peace-amid-heavy-fighting-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-region

item.title: CAS to rule on Africa Cup of Nations title on Tuesday
item.description:
The Court of Arbitration for Sport said on Monday it will issue its ruling on Tuesday on Senegal’s appeal against being stripped of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations title. Senegal beat Morocco 1-0 after extra time in the final in Rabat before CAF declared Morocco champions with a 3-0 forfeit result.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/11/23/senegal-africa-cup-of-nations-afcon-morocco-cas-decision-appeal · Al Raya (AP) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%BA%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%82%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%84-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A3%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7

item.title: Alcaraz beats Zverev to win maiden ATP Finals title
item.description:
Spain’s Carlos Alcaraz won his first ATP Finals title on Sunday evening in Turin, beating world number one Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6 (9-7). The 23-year-old joined Andre Agassi, Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic as the only players to have completed the career Grand Slam and won the ATP Finals.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/11/23/carlos-alcaraz-atp-finals-2026-title-alexander-zverev-tennis · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/sport/tennis/carlos-alcaraz-joins-federer-djokovic-and-agassi-in-elite-tennis-club-after-2026-atp-finals-title-1.500757764
